### Priority list
1. `#main > div.testimonial-card` (×3) — these three repeated cards make up the entire visible content and text of the page; getting their structure/order/text exact matters most.
2. `#main > h1` — "What people say" is the only heading, spans the full width, and sits above all cards.

The raw HTML has no `<link rel="stylesheet">`, no `<style>` block, and no inline `style` attributes anywhere — this is unstyled semantic markup relying entirely on browser UA defaults. I'll confirm the actual rendered base styles with windtailor rather than assume, then build the clone as a faithful copy of the semantic structure.
